newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU clears Generali buy of Fiat insurance unit.
newsitem.headline: EU clears Generali buy of Fiat insurance unit.

text.p: The European Commission said on Friday it had approved the acquisition by Generali of Fiat unit Prime in the field of life insurance and investment funds.

"Even though Generali is the leading Italian group in the field of Italian life insurance, this purchase does not risk creating or strengthening a dominant position in the Common Market given the minor importance of Prime's activities in this field," the Commission said in a statement explaining its decision.
